_note: 學習路徑內容建置第14批 #6／6：關係子句化簡為分詞（eng.t_adv.relcl.reduce-to-participle，學測級／高階）。關係子句『關代＋be』可以化簡成分詞片語：the man who is standing → the man standing。鐵律：名詞『做動作』（主動）用現在分詞 -ing（the boy who is playing → the boy playing）；名詞『被…』（被動）用過去分詞 p.p.（the car which was made → the car made）；依語意的主動／被動選 -ing 或 p.p.，不是只看時態。誘答以『主動被動選錯（-ing↔p.p.）／保留 to／用原形』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix rdc_）。

units.title_zh: 關係子句化簡為分詞（the man standing…）
units.can_do: 我能把『關代＋be』的關係子句化簡成分詞片語（the man who is standing → the man standing），知道名詞做動作（主動）用現在分詞 -ing、名詞被…（被動）用過去分詞 p.p.，並依語意的主動／被動正確選 -ing 或 p.p.。
units.situation_group: 關係子句 Reduce to participle
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A relative clause with 'who/which + be' can be shortened to a participle phrase by dropping the pronoun and 'be': 'the man who is standing' -> 'the man standing.'
claims.verification_ref: 關代＋be 的關係子句可去掉關代與 be 化簡為分詞片語；the man who is standing → the man standing；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the noun does the action (active meaning), use the present participle (-ing): 'the boy who is playing' -> 'the boy playing.'
claims.verification_ref: 名詞做動作（主動）用現在分詞 -ing；the boy who is playing → the boy playing；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the noun receives the action (passive meaning), use the past participle: 'the car which was made in Japan' -> 'the car made in Japan.'
claims.verification_ref: 名詞被…（被動）用過去分詞 p.p.；the car which was made → the car made；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Choose '-ing' or the past participle by meaning (active vs passive), not by tense alone: 'the people invited to the party' (passive) vs 'the people coming to the party' (active).
claims.verification_ref: 依語意主動／被動選 -ing 或 p.p.、非只看時態；the people invited（被動）vs the people coming（主動）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: If a relative clause is 'relative pronoun + be + ...', you can drop the relative pronoun and 'be' together and reduce it to a participle phrase: the man who is standing -> the man standing. The meaning is the same, just shorter.
teach.zh_hint: 關係子句如果是『關代＋be＋…』，可以把關代和 be 一起去掉，化簡成一個分詞片語：the man who is standing（站著的那個人）→ the man standing。意思一樣，更簡潔。

teach.body: The man standing by the door is my uncle.
teach.zh_hint: 站在門邊的那個人是我叔叔。由 who is standing 化簡。

teach.body: Key point: if the noun is doing the action itself (active), use the present participle -ing: the boy who is playing -> the boy playing.
teach.zh_hint: 重點：名詞如果是『自己在做動作』（主動），用現在分詞 -ing：the boy who is playing → the boy playing。

teach.body: The boy playing football is my brother.
teach.zh_hint: 在踢足球的那個男孩是我弟弟。主動用 -ing。

teach.body: If the noun receives the action (passive), use the past participle: the car which was made in Japan -> the car made in Japan. Choose -ing or the past participle by whether the meaning is active or passive, not just by the tense.
teach.zh_hint: 名詞如果是『被…』（被動），用過去分詞 p.p.：the car which was made in Japan → the car made in Japan。選 -ing 還是 p.p.，看語意是主動還是被動，不是只看時態。

teach.body: The car made in Japan is very popular.
teach.zh_hint: 日本製的那輛車很受歡迎。被動用 p.p. made。

practice.stem: 化簡：the woman who is cooking → the woman ____

distractor_rationales.cooked: the woman 是自己在煮（主動），用現在分詞 cooking；cooked 是被動／過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.to cook: 化簡不用 to 不定詞；主動用 -ing：cooking。
distractor_rationales.cooks: 化簡成分詞片語，不用動詞原形；用 cooking。

practice.feedback: 主動用現在分詞：the woman cooking。

practice.stem: 化簡：the letter which was sent yesterday → the letter ____ yesterday

distractor_rationales.sending: the letter 是『被寄出』（被動），用過去分詞 sent；sending 是主動。
distractor_rationales.to send: 化簡不用 to 不定詞；被動用過去分詞 sent。
distractor_rationales.sends: 化簡成分詞片語，不用動詞原形；被動用 sent。

practice.feedback: 被動用過去分詞：the letter sent yesterday。

practice.stem: 選正確分詞：The people ____ in the garden are my friends.（他們正在花園裡玩——主動）

distractor_rationales.played: 他們是自己在玩（主動），用現在分詞 playing；played 是被動／過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.to play: 這裡要分詞片語，不用 to 不定詞；主動用 playing。
distractor_rationales.play: 不用動詞原形；主動用現在分詞 playing。

practice.feedback: 主動（他們在玩）用現在分詞：the people playing。

practice.stem: 選正確分詞：The house ____ last year looks new.（它去年被蓋好——被動）

distractor_rationales.building: 房子是『被蓋』（被動），用過去分詞 built；房子不會自己蓋，不用 building。
distractor_rationales.to build: 這裡要分詞片語，不用 to 不定詞；被動用 built。
distractor_rationales.builds: 不用動詞原形；被動用過去分詞 built。

practice.feedback: 被動（房子被蓋）用過去分詞：the house built last year。

practice.stem: 哪一個正確化簡 'the song which was written by her'？
options: the song to write by her

distractor_rationales.the song writing by her: 歌是『被寫』（被動），用過去分詞 written；writing 是主動。
distractor_rationales.the song wrote by her: 被動要用過去分詞 written，不是過去式 wrote。
distractor_rationales.the song to write by her: 化簡不用 to 不定詞；被動用 written。

practice.feedback: 被動用過去分詞：the song written by her。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The boy standing there is my friend.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：standing（主動現在分詞）有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。分詞片語與主句連貫、句尾下收。

lines.text: The man standing there is my teacher.
lines.intonation: The man standing there 微停、is my teacher 句尾下收

lines.text: The car made in Japan is popular.
lines.intonation: The car made in Japan 微停、is popular 句尾下收
